newsitem.title: FRANCE: SOCCER-BRAZILIAN PENPIX FOR TOURNOI DE FRANCE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BRAZILIAN PENPIX FOR TOURNOI DE FRANCE.

text.p: Profiles of the Brazilian squad for the Tournoi de France starting on Tuesday:
Goalkeepers:

Taffarel (Full name - Claudio Andre Mergen Taffarel) (Atletico Mineiro), age 30, 75 caps. Brazil's regular goalkeeper from 1988 to 1995, including the last two World Cups. He stepped down after criticism of his performance in the 1995 Copa America, vowing not to play again, but was recalled earlier this year after a re-think.
Carlos Germano (Carlos Germano Schwambach) (Vasco da Gama) 26, 6. Has played in a handful of friendlies but never in a major international tournament.
Defenders:

Aldair (Aldair Nascimento Santos) (Roma) 31, 47. Called in at the last minute for the 1994 World Cup after the three first-choice defenders were forced out through injury, he played in every game and has been a regular choice ever since. Played in last year's Atlanta Olympics as an over-age player.
Cafu (Marcos Evangelista de Moraes) (Palmeiras) 26, 45. Has taken over from Jorginho as the automatic choice for the right-back position.
Celio Silva (Vagno Celio da Nascimento Silva) (Corinthians) 29, 7. Played in a smattering of friendlies since 1992. Possesses one of the most powerful shots in the game.

Goncalves (Marcelo Goncalves Costa Lopes) (Botafogo) 31, 6. Made belated appearance on the international scene, a five-year spell in Mexican soccer possibly keeping him out of the view of the national team coach. Inspired Botafogo as they won the Brazilian championship in 1995.

Marcio Santos (Marcio Roberto dos Santos) (Atletico Mineiro) 27, 38. Made his mark at the 1994 World Cup after injuries to three other defenders gave him a chance. A troubled spell at Dutch club Ajax led to a loss of form and a lost place in the national squad but he was recalled for April's friendly with Mexico.

Roberto Carlos (Roberto Carlos da Silva) (Real Madrid) 24, 29. Fast and powerful left-back with a thunderous shot. Played in the last two Copa America tournaments and the Atlanta Olympics but was controversially left out of the 1994 World Cup squad.
Ze Maria (Jose Marcelo Ferreira) (Real Madrid) 23, 4 caps. Surprise choice as Cafu's reserve. Many though Vasco defender Pimentel deserved the place. Played in the Atlanta Games last year.
Midfielders:

Cesar Sampaio (Carlos Cesar Sampaio Campos) (Yokohama Flugels) 29, 23 caps. Defensive midfielder who played in the 1993 and 1995 Copa America tournaments but was overlooked for the last World Cup. His recall for last month's friendly against Mexico ended a two-year absence from the national team.
Denilson (Denilson de Oliveira) (Sao Paulo) 19, 3. Pacey, left-sided player of enormous promise.

Djalminha (Djalma Feitosa Dias) (Palmeiras) 26, 5. Hugely gifted left-footed player who is seen as a potential playmaker, if he can keep his temper under control. He has been sent off three times this year in club matches and was once thrown out of Flamengo for coming to blows with a team mate during a game. His father Djalma Dias was a Brazil international.

Dunga (Carlos Caetano Verri) (Jubilo Iwata) 33, 67. Gritty midfielder who captained the 1994 World Cup team. Seemed to be heading towards a quiet end to his career when he headed for Japan but was surprisingly recalled this year after an 18-month absence.
Flavio Conceicao (Flavio da Conceicao) (Deportivo Coruna) 22, 7 caps. Combatative midfielder who made his name with Palmeiras. Played in the Atlanta Olympics.

Giovanni (Giovanni Silva de Oliveira) (Barcelona) 25, 11. Elegant player who made his name with Santos. Fighting Djalminha and Juninho, who was left out of the squad, for the main midfield role. Inconsistency and problems at his club, where he has been subjected to spells on the substitutes' bench, have affected his international form.
